hooks.command: for c in python3 python "py -3" py; do if $c -c 'import sys;sys.exit(0)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec $c "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/boot.py" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; fi; done; echo "NOTE (workstream boot): no Python interpreter resolved (tried python3, python, py -3, py) - workstream identity is NOT loaded this session." >&2; exit 0
